**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent moves a piece, look for loose pieces behind it. Black's rook on a8 became undefended after d5. The check Nc7+ forces the king away, leaving the rook trapped. Your knight forks the king and rook—the king must move, then you take the undefended rook. Watch for checks that exploit loose pieces on the back rank or edges of the board.
